newsitem.title: USA: Siemens unit to offer 10 mln shares at $8.5-$10.5.
newsitem.headline: Siemens unit to offer 10 mln shares at $8.5-$10.5.

text.p: Rofin-Sinar Technologies Inc, a unit of German electronics and electrical equipment giant Siemens AG, said it plans to offer 10 million shares at an estimated $8.5 to $10.5 each when it goes public.
The puts the value of the deal at about $95 million, based on a pricing in the midpoint of the $8.5-$10.5 range.
Rofin-Sinar, in a regulatory filing, said it would use $70.3 million of net proceeds to buy its assets from Siemens and Siemens's U.S. subsidiary Siemens Power Corp.
Rofin-Sinar will keep about $19 million of net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including repayment of $7 million of debt owed to Siemens.
The company is tentatively scheduled to make its market debut during the week of September 23, said the underwriter, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Rofin-Sinar makes laser products for cutting, welding and marking industrial materials.
